label: Teltonika TRB160
description: A gigabit 4G Cat 6 gateway in a small industrial case: one RJ45 at 10/100/1000, USB Type-C, no switch and no radio.
notes: Vendor figures from the TRB160 datasheet: 1 x RJ45 port 10/100/1000 Mbps Ethernet; USB Type-C; 4G LTE Cat 6, modelled at the 300 Mbps downlink class. No Wi-Fi.
